steps.content: You traverse the crumbling streets. The once cheerful festive lanterns have now turned into raging flames, devouring crops and emitting acrid smoke so dense that it forces your eyes shut. Wails of anguish echo like cursed mantras, reverberating through your skull and tearing at your mind.

Inferno and miasma corrode flesh and brick alike, while screams of terror blend with manic shrieks. Humans transform into monsters—the same monsters you know all too well. Reality warps under contamination as Mania spawns Corruptors. This scene, in all its horror, is painfully familiar to you.
These streets, where people celebrated joyously at the fete mere hours ago, are now a living hell.
You force yourself to take deep breaths, constantly reminding yourself to stay focused on your mission.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I must find Yingying...

Though your mind is clouded, your direction remains clear. Amid the ruins, a path of purple emerges—wisteria blossoms strewn across the earth. Their vibrant hue cuts through the chaos, forming veins of purple that lead to the core.

You struggle forward, steadying yourself against broken walls as shadowy figures sweep past you. Their voices seep into your mind. Although the language is foreign to you, a strange intuition allows you to grasp the meaning behind their words.

steps.speaker: Resident C
steps.content: Monsters... so many monsters... argh... help us... Wisteria Fairy, save us...

steps.speaker: Resident A
steps.content: It's okay, it's okay... the flowers are still blooming... the Fairy is still there. May the Wisteria Fairy watch over us...

steps.speaker: Resident B
steps.content: Protect us, protect us... *sob*...
Prayers, resembling a rhythmic chant, echo outward from the ruins of the Wisteria Pavilion.
Though they pray, their words lack the conviction of true believers. Each syllable drips with fear and despair, as both survival and prayer have been reduced to mere bodily responses.
Inside you, the shackles writhe restlessly, sending sharp jolts of pain through your body, as if trying to deliver a warning—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Something's wrong...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is no natural disaster. Taking shelter like this won't save anyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is Mania... If all these affected people gather together like this—
You break into a sprint, racing desperately to the Wisteria Pavilion. At the entrance, the "moms" are anxiously ushering people inside.
[Wisteria Mom's portrait]

steps.speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
steps.content: Sh-she's not here. She went out to help—there‘s still people trapped outside. She went to save them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll go find her.
Before leaving, you grab the woman's shoulders and call out:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Corruptors have already shown up! The Mania contamination is spreading—the Wisteria Fairy can't protect you anymore!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Tell everyone to stop gathering here and run!
Your urgent shouts startle her.

steps.speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
steps.content: ...Corruptors? Mania? Have you lost your mind, young one? This is the sacred fete of the Wisteria Fairy—our divine tree has protected us for a millennium. Everyone here came to receive its blessings.
steps.female_content: ...Corruptors? Mania? Have you lost your mind, young lady? This is the sacred fete of the Wisteria Fairy—our divine tree has protected us for a millennium. Everyone here came to receive its blessings.

steps.speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
steps.content: Even if the legends aren't real, how dare you claim it means us harm! And telling us to leave... Well then, you tell me...

steps.speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
steps.content: After everything that's happened, where else can we possibly go?

steps.speaker: Wisteria Flower Spirit
steps.content: If our divine tree can't save us, who even will?!
The woman's face suddenly turns pitch-black, and the void where her features once were lunges straight at you.
At that moment, your shackles glow crimson, swiftly cutting through the murky vines coiling around you. During the struggle, you stumble backward, and then—
—BOOM!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hey!

A thunderous crash erupts from within the courtyard as contamination tears through walls and gates, coalescing into wildly thrashing vines. Before you can make out the screams of anguish from inside, a dark shape strikes you in the forehead, sending you flying backward.

When your vision returns, you witness the courtyard, once blessed by the Wisteria Fairy, crumble into ruins in an instant. All its vitality transforms into roaring Mania tendrils, while the wisteria tree burns amidst flames and contamination—whether being destroyed or undergoing a twisted rebirth into a new monster, you cannot tell.
You remain frozen in place for what feels like an eternity before slowly rising to your feet. The flames sear your eyes, forcing you to look away from the devastating scene before you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...This... it's just an illusion... I can't change anything... it's in the past...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Find Yingying, resolve the crisis outside... resolve... now...
You get to your feet, turn around, and try to force yourself to move forward.
But as you turn around, you find her standing right before you.
[Past Yingying's portrait]
Yingying shields several children, the fiery flames reflected her eyes. Her lips tremble, her face deathly pale, yet she appears completely numb to the burning embers falling on her skin.
She approaches you with slow steps, gently placing the child from her arms into yours before proceeding on her path. You hear her words, barely a whisper:

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...O Wisteria Fairy above, O Wisteria Fairy... above...
As she passes by you, murmuring those words, your shackles begin to tremble, signaling the awakening of a sinister power within Yingying. You instinctively move to stop her.

Yet, suddenly, the child in your arms transforms into a heavy stone, from which black-purple vines burst forth and coil around your limbs. Unable to break free, you can only watch helplessly as she walks into the crumbling ruins.
